links.covers: Acid/base: reference ranges and compensation (ABG interpretation)
DKA: glucose, pH, AG, bicarb, urine/serum ketones
Nonketotic hyperglycemia (HHS) vs DKA: ⍉ketones, norm pH and AG
Hyperkalemia: Dx labs and EKG chgs
DI: serum and urine osmol, fluid deprivation test
Prerenal AKI: BUN/Cr ratio, FENa, urine Na and osmol
ATN: BUN/Cr ratio, FENa, urine osmol, muddy brown casts
ACS: high-sensitivity troponin and CK-MB timing
HF: BNP/NT-proBNP cutoffs and other labs
DVT: D-dimer to r/o w ↓/mod pretest probability
PE: Wells/PERC pretest probability, CBC/CMP, ABG
B12 deficiency: CBC w periph smear
Aplastic anemia: CBC w smear, reticulocytes, marrow bx
Cirrhosis: hepatic encephalopathy from ammonia accum
Transfusion: 1 unit PRBCs raises Hgb by 1 g/dL
Abruptio placentae Dx: CBC, type and cross, fibrinogen
Infective endocarditis: blood cultures x3 b4 abx
Septic arthritis: blood cultures, ESR/CRP, procal, arthrocentesis
Abortion: CBC, blood type and Rh screen, serial beta-hCG, anti-D
PID Dx: UPT, NAAT, vaginal d/c microscopy, HIV, RPR/VDRL
Bact vaginosis: wet mount clue cells, pH, whiff test
Epididymitis: UA, NAAT for gonorrhea and chlamydia
Compartment syndrome: compartment P >30 mmHg, CK and myoglobin
Palpitations labs: CMP, CBC, TSH, urine tox
Burns labs: CBC, lytes, BUN/Cr, glucose, VBG, carboxyhemoglobin
Adrenal crisis labs: Na, K, glucose, cortisol, ACTH, renin
Bact meningitis: when to CT b4 LP, CSF pattern
SAH: LP for xanthochromia if CT (−)
Bundle branch and fascicular blocks: QRS duration, axis deviation
ACS: UA vs NSTEMI vs STEMI
Acute pericarditis: diffuse ST elevation and PR depression
Pericardial effusion: electrical alternans, low-voltage QRS
AV blocks: PR prolongation thru complete block
AVNRT: rate 120-200, P wave buried in QRS
AVRT: orthodromic narrow QRS vs antidromic
WPW: delta wave, short PR, wide QRS
Hyperkalemia: peaked T waves to QRS widening, sine waves
Pneumothorax: CXR pleural line, deep sulcus sign
Ankle sprain: Ottawa rules, XR views
Ischemic CVA: noncontrast head CT first, CTA/MRA
Epidural hematoma: lens-shaped bleed on CT
Subdural hematoma: crescent-shaped bleed on CT
SAH: noncontrast CT, then LP if (−)
Hypertensive emergencies: chest CTA for dissection, brain CT for CVA
Mesenteric ischemia: CTA abd and pelvis
Bowel obstruct: XR/CT air-fluid levels, 3-6-9 rule
AAA: focused bedside US in unstable pts
Herniated disk: MRI for red flags
Epiglottitis: lat neck XR thumbprint sign
Croup: frontal neck XR steeple sign
Vertebral fractures: NEXUS criteria for C-spine imaging
Prox humerus frx: axillary n. inj
Spinal cord inj: mech of inj
Supracondylar frx: long arm posterior splint
Radial head frx: sling or posterior long arm splint
Bact meningitis: when to CT b4 LP
Epistaxis: anterior and posterior nasal packing
Sick sinus: atropine, temp and permanent pacing
Hypertensive crises: CVA BP thresholds for thrombolysis
